The '''House Organa Medical Bay''' was a scientific facility located within [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]]’s [[House Organa (estate)|estate]], near their [[Castle Organa|castle]].

In [[3643 BBY]], a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] participating in the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]] arrived in the area to eliminate the [[Corwin|Durasteel Duke]]. However, he was confronted by the [[Muriel Corwin|duke’s sister]], who, along with [[Vala Organa]], explained the truth about her brother’s death. The mercenary then took the duke’s body after destroying the capsule before leaving.
